title: AutoComplete
description: A text input that suggests matching options while the user types.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Options whose label contains the typed text are suggested; inputProps are forwarded to the input.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: value / onChange control the input text, onSelect reports the chosen option and onDropdownVisibleChange the dropdown state.

rich-options.title: Icons, descriptions and states
rich-options.description: In basic mode an option can have an icon and a description, and can be highlighted or disabled.

custom-render.title: Custom rendering
custom-render.description: Set mode="custom" and renderOption to fully control how options look; renderEmpty replaces the empty state.

grouped.title: Grouped options
grouped.description: groupBy returns a group name for each option; groups are shown under headings in order of appearance.

filter-sort.title: Custom filter and sort
filter-sort.description: filterOption replaces the default "contains" matching and sortOption orders the results.

async-loading.title: Remote search
async-loading.description: Fetch options as the user types and show loading while the request is pending.

appearance.title: Dropdown placement and colors
appearance.description: Customize placement, offset and animation, and recolor the dropdown, hovered and highlighted options with the --auto-complete-dropdown-background, --auto-complete-option-hover-background and --auto-complete-option-highlight-background CSS custom properties set through dropdownClassName. The dropdown is aligned with the input's start edge, is at least as wide as the input, and flips / shifts to stay in the viewport.

search-box.title: Search box
search-box.description: autoHighlight makes Enter pick the first suggestion, fillOnSelect={false} keeps the typed text, and onSubmit runs a search when no option is active.

keyboard.title: Keyboard and accessibility
keyboard.arrows: Arrow Down / Arrow Up move through the visible options (wrapping around).
keyboard.enter: Enter selects the active option (disabled options are skipped) without submitting the surrounding form.
keyboard.escape: Escape closes the dropdown and keeps focus in the input; with the dropdown already closed it clears the text (onChange receives ""). Inside a Modal or Popover only the dropdown closes.
keyboard.aria: The input exposes the combobox role with aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant pointing to the listbox options.

AutoCompleteProps.name: Name of the input
AutoCompleteProps.label: Label of the input
AutoCompleteProps.mode: "basic" renders icon / label / description; "custom" uses renderOption
AutoCompleteProps.onChange: Called when the input text changes (typing or selecting an option)
AutoCompleteProps.onSelect: Called when an option is picked (mouse or keyboard)
AutoCompleteProps.groupBy: Returns the group name of an option; options are grouped under headings
AutoCompleteProps.renderOption: Custom option renderer (used when mode is "custom")
AutoCompleteProps.renderEmpty: Custom content shown when no option matches
AutoCompleteProps.loading: Shows a loading indicator in the dropdown
AutoCompleteProps.inputProps: Props forwarded to the underlying Input (native attributes, aria-label, size, prefix / suffix, clearable...)
AutoCompleteProps.emptyProps: Props forwarded to the default Empty state
AutoCompleteProps.dropdownClassName: Additional class name of the dropdown (portalled) element. It can set the --auto-complete-dropdown-background, --auto-complete-option-hover-background and --auto-complete-option-highlight-background CSS custom properties to recolor the dropdown, hovered options and highlighted options
AutoCompleteProps.placement: Preferred dropdown side; the dropdown is aligned with the input's start edge, is at least as wide as the input, and flips / shifts to stay in the viewport
AutoCompleteProps.offset: Dropdown offset in pixels: for top / bottom placements y is the gap to the input and x shifts along it; for left / right placements x is the gap
AutoCompleteProps.animation: Animates the dropdown when it opens
AutoCompleteProps.filterOption: Custom filter; by default options whose label contains the input (case-insensitive) are shown
AutoCompleteProps.sortOption: Compare function used to sort the filtered options
AutoCompleteProps.onOptionClick: Called when an option is clicked with the mouse
AutoCompleteProps.onDropdownVisibleChange: Called when the dropdown opens or closes (not on mount)
AutoCompleteProps.onSubmit: Called with the trimmed text when Enter is pressed while no option is active (e.g. to search)
AutoCompleteProps.autoHighlight: Makes the first enabled option active whenever the dropdown opens or the options change
AutoCompleteProps.fillOnSelect: Writes the label of the picked option into the input
AutoCompleteProps.className: Additional class name of the root element
AutoCompleteProps.groupMode: "first" groups options at their first appearance, "adjacent" groups runs of consecutive options; group "" has no heading

AutoCompleteOption.label: Text displayed for the option and written to the input when selected
AutoCompleteOption.disabled: Prevents the option from being selected
AutoCompleteOption.highlight: Highlights the option (e.g. as a recommendation)
AutoCompleteOption.icon: Icon displayed before the label (basic mode)
AutoCompleteOption.description: Secondary text displayed under the label (basic mode)
AutoCompleteOption.group: Free-form group identifier, typically read by groupBy

cssVars.--auto-complete-dropdown-radius: Corner radius of the dropdown (defaults to --radius-lg)
cssVars.--auto-complete-dropdown-max-height: Maximum height of the option list before it scrolls
cssVars.--auto-complete-option-padding-y: Vertical padding of an option (follows the density's row padding)
cssVars.--auto-complete-option-padding-x: Horizontal padding of an option and of a group label
cssVars.--auto-complete-option-hover-background: Background of the hovered / keyboard-focused option
cssVars.--auto-complete-option-highlight-backgro: Background of options with highlight: true
